detailed_description:
Photoreal live-action Seoul morning-life montage, 16:9, natural human skin and fabric, soft warm window light, intimate medium-close shots and tactile inserts, realistic motion and restrained depth of field. Face and neck exclusively from <Video 1>; body and short front-spiked hair from <Picture 1>; sleepwear from <Picture 2>. No mannequin material in the finished video. Natural speed, motivated occlusion transitions and movement matches, no dissolves or morphing. Camera travel remains screen-right.
[Shot 1] Hold 2.500 seconds. Extreme close-up at bedside level, locked then a tiny push. The alarm clock vibrates on the nightstand. Still drowsy with eyes closed, he reaches in from screen-left, feels for the top button, presses it, and the alarm stops. His face remains asleep in soft focus behind the clock.
[Shot 2] At 00:02.500, CUT TO: tight close-up from his left-front 45 degrees, gentle handheld drift. After the alarm stops, he opens his eyes, blinks once, exhales, and shifts his gaze toward the window. Face and neck identity strictly from <Video 1>. A pillow edge briefly wipes across the lens.
[Shot 3] At 00:05.000, CUT TO: medium close-up from the bed's right side, short clockwise orbit. He pushes himself upright with one hand on the mattress, swings both feet to the floor, and steadies before standing.
[Shot 4] At 00:07.500, CUT TO: close-up from behind his right shoulder, slow lateral move. He draws the curtain toward screen-right; bright white fabric fills the lens on the final frame as a directional wipe.

overall_soundscape:
Quiet Seoul morning room tone, faint birds and distant traffic. Alarm buzz stops under his fingertip, followed by sheet rustle, a footstep, curtain rings and fabric swish. No dialogue or intelligible speech.
